mandate: C335 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW TOXICITY / VPIN SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per-bar toxicity: vpin_bkt=|signed_volume|/total_volume, vpin_ewm=EWMA(vpin_bkt,halflife=24 bars), toxicity_park=|signed_volume|/notional; per (weekday,tod) bucket over trailing seasonal baseline at same bucket: score=-(v - expanding mean of prev v). Signals: vpin_bkt_dev, vpin_ewm_dev, toxicity_park_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and toxicity-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: total_volume<=0 -> vpin_bkt NaN; notional<=0 -> toxicity_park NaN; vpin_ewm NaN until >= 24 finite obs (no ffill/impute); same-bucket seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw log_return/signed_volume/notional fields carry zero NaN.

data_quality.note: toxicity score NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~MIN_PREV_BASELINE same-bucket occurrences per bucket) plus total_volume/notional zeros; zero-activity bars add negligible mass.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume/notional/total_volume real from C312.
methodology.signals: per (weekday,tod) bucket over trailing seasonal baseline: vpin_bkt=|signed_volume|/total_volume, vpin_ewm=EWMA(vpin_bkt,24 bars), toxicity_park=|signed_volume|/notional; score=-(v-expanding mean of prev v at same bucket); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs toxicity_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
